_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code config for the Workshop.Api demo repo.

hooks._comment: Stop hook runs dotnet test when Claude finishes a turn. --nologo --verbosity quiet keeps the output to just failures. Output is fed back to Claude so it can react to a red test run before declaring victory. Comment out the entry below if you want quieter live-demo iterations.

mcpServers._comment: Read-only filesystem MCP scoped to this repo. Requires npx (Node.js) on PATH. The server is sandboxed to the directory passed as the final arg, so it cannot read anything outside the repo. Swap for GitHub MCP by replacing with: command=npx, args=[-y, @modelcontextprotocol/server-github] and setting GITHUB_TOKEN in env.
